doc.name: Agency Capacity
doc.instructions: AGL Agency Capacity gives agency teams capacity math, published benchmarks, a client context file template, an AI work approval checklist and a glossary. Results are estimates from the user's inputs. add_to_benchmark stores anonymous numbers only when the user agrees.

tools.name: capacity_check
tools.title: Agency capacity check
tools.description: Estimates an agency's accounts per account manager, yearly coordination cost, and how many more accounts the same team could carry at a target ratio. Use when the user shares client and team numbers and asks about capacity, hiring, or account manager load. Returns an estimate, not a guarantee.

account_managers.description: People who own client accounts day to day.

avg_monthly_retainer.description: Average monthly retainer per client in USD. Optional.

hours_lost_per_am_per_week.description: Hours each account manager loses per week to re-briefing AI, chasing approvals, fixing work and reporting. Optional.

loaded_hourly_cost.description: Loaded hourly cost of an account manager in USD. Optional.

target_accounts_per_am.description: Target accounts per account manager. Default 18.

tools.name: rebrief_tax
tools.title: Re-brief tax estimate
tools.description: Estimates the monthly hours and cost a team spends explaining clients to AI tools before they do useful work. Use when the user asks what re-briefing AI or re-pasting client context costs.

minutes_per_rebrief.description: Minutes spent loading client context into a new AI chat.

rebriefs_per_account_per_week.description: New AI chats per account per person each week.

people.description: People who use AI on client work.

hourly_cost.description: Loaded hourly cost in USD. Optional.

tools.name: capacity_benchmarks
tools.title: Agency capacity benchmarks
tools.description: Returns published benchmarks on accounts per account manager, time spent re-briefing AI, and rework of AI output, each with its source link. Use when the user asks what is normal for agencies.

tools.name: client_context_template
tools.title: Client context file template
tools.description: Returns a fill-in template for a 1-file client context document (goals, voice, claims rules, priorities, approvals, decisions) for a service line. Use when the user wants AI tools or new teammates to stop needing a client re-brief.

service_line.description: general, seo, paid_media, content, lifecycle, or automation. Default general.

client_name.description: Optional client name to put in the title.

tools.name: define_term
tools.title: Agency AI operations glossary
tools.description: Defines an agency AI operations term, such as Portable Delivery Intelligence, accounts per person, re-brief tax, or AI operations sprawl. Leave term empty to list all terms.
